description: C-47A-65-DL c/n 18993, USAAF 42-100530 (a Normandy D-Day veteran), then Brazilian Air Force FAB 2052 for 30 years, PT-KVN, and to Transportes Aéreos San Jorge of Trinidad in 1984 as CP-1960 (or CP-1990 - Aerospotter is unsure which). Crashed near hacienda San Juan on a test flight 2 November 1992 and stored at Trinidad airport; the fuselage and wings were donated by the widow of Capt. Yeral Ortiz and installed in mid-2022 on the new plazuela with a pilot statue and fountain. Engines are missing and sheet-metal dummy propellers fitted; the true identity is still stencilled under the left wing. Tail left blank because the Bolivian registration is uncertain.
museum_name: Plazuela El Aviador C-47 Monument, Trinidad
